testcase.system-out: Scenario: Extrude between two faces independent of the source sketch plane ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/midplane-circle-between-faces-candidate.opd` is open ✔ And the user makes Sketch2 visible and starts Extrude with its circle selected ✔ And the profile plane lies between the block's top and bottom planar faces ✔ And the projected profile lies inside both face boundaries ✔ When the user selects the first face as From and the second as To ✔ Then the extrusion preview starts on the first face and terminates on the second ✔ And neither cap lies on the original sketch plane
